==Dialogue==
:''"Does this corsair outfit make me look fat?"''

:''"Will this interminable shift never end?"''

:''"Some [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]] fight for Istan.  I die for her... repeatedly"''

:''"My recruiter will hear about this!"''

==Notes==
* Although a Sunspear, they are dressed as a [[corsair]].
* Before the [[Game updates/20081009|October 9th 2008 update]] this [[NPC]] was known as [[Corsair Prisoner]].
* Like [[practice target]]s, he will be resurrected upon death automatically after 30 seconds.
